sharedProcedure.access: Preserve Druid/Mage/Wizard native rank 9, minimum class 17, base 26 RP, additional 0 RP, Action and 120 feet. Forge Conjuration V/S/F; Conversion Transmutation V/S/M-or-F. Use actual acquired repertoire, components, focus permission and preparation, not merely class eligibility. No feat, recipe, trade or tool credential is granted.
sharedProcedure.commitment: Preflight actual choices, perception, line of effect, range, accessible body/lot, authorization, components, Action and final legal price. Before payment, missing authorization/profile or known illegality rejects with no cost. Commit exactly one Action, actual priced RP, chronological Dissonance/Refrain and cast history; then actual Counterspell window. No refund for a counter or late-invalid payload. No extra concentration requirement is added by these spells. Existing concentration changes only through actual interfaces.
sharedProcedure.classHooks: Prepared Wizard first-family base Dissonance exemption is per real encounter; duplicate matrices do not multiply it. Repeats retain Refrain. Conjuration creature HP bonus does not apply to items. Automatic creation introduces no Arcane Experimentation check. No research success, trade XP, harvest XP, proficiency or item charge comes from spell access.
sharedProcedure.ordering: NEW spell-local transaction: freeze immutable cast ID, caster/class/school/rank, requested versioned profile and exact target IDs at commitment. At resolution compare target revisions and reservations, then commit all payload mutations atomically. Failed compare-and-swap makes no partial output. Concurrent local transactions use existing initiative then stable actor/cast IDs fixed before declaration. Never retarget after payment. Idempotent event IDs replay no payment, item or charge.
sharedProcedure.knowledge: Show only legitimately known output profiles and visible availability/costs. Internal hidden refusal facts do not identify secret ingredients, item properties or formulas. Director authorization records a specific permitted profile version; 687 reviewed recipes are not 687 public grants. Preserve 433 public, 39 restricted, 215 Director recipes and 92 restricted materials.
sharedProcedure.providers: Ready uses its actual paid preparation and Reaction release/expiry contract. Copy/reflection/storage require an acquired provider and its exact eligibility, costs, caster attribution and finite source lineage. No generic free copy and no reliance on unaccepted Cast Echo. If a provider cannot be shown, that route remains unavailable in evidence, not globally forbidden.
sharedProcedure.state: Persist object/lot ID and revision; root cast and generating rank; parent-child provenance with exact rational quantities; three-dimensional occupied region; material composition and phase; owner/custodian and reservations; damage deficit and maximum/current HP; charges and every processed dawn ID; visibility/knowledge separate from physical truth; caster budgets, regular starts, recharge, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain; costs, failed commitments and terminal reason. Full-state test/replace inverses are evidence rollback only, never in-world refunds.

spellLocalNEW.output: NEW: one explicitly identified separable nonmagical object or connected bulk lot, maximum100lb per cast. Preserve actual mass exactly using rational pounds; no market-value conservation. Convert all selected mass to a specifically authorized material composition/phase/purity. Stone-to-mithril remains an eligible valuable conversion, not currency minting. No sentience, soul, magical ability, counterfeit certification or monster provenance from a name.
spellLocalNEW.physicalContract: NEW: preserve topology and relative shape by uniform scale determined by actual input and output volume; output volume equals mass divided by authorized output density. Units must be explicit and exact, with no rounded material duplication. If either physical profile lacks density/structural mapping, resolve authorization before payment; do not infer it from price. This return does not assign mithril a made-up density or AC. A future explicit game-parameter authorization may supply them without pretending to recover a source fact.
spellLocalNEW.categories: NEW: eligible loose stock, complete nonliving objects, explicitly separable nonliving components, contained liquid/gas, food and nonanimated corpse matter. Entire living/animated bodies and inseparable organs are outside this utility completion; this is a local restriction, not a universal nonmagical-material definition. Hostile worn/held/attached custody requires explicit custodian consent; no new hostile save is invented. Independently separable stock in a consenting container may qualify. Magical target body/imprint makes that selected object ineligible; do not strip its magic for free. Independently external magical contents remain separate and must be placed without overlap.
spellLocalNEW.structure: NEW: keep workmanship, grade, contamination, custody, remaining components and actual damage deficit. New maxHP and AC require the authorized material/body model; currentHP=max(0,newMaxHP-oldDamageDeficit), capped at newMaxHP. No repair, enchantment, refill, machining, new weapon profile or recipe completion. If a stronger material permits an existing deficit to yield positiveHP, that is the explicit material mapping, not a reset; missing original parts remain missing.
spellLocalNEW.fit: NEW: output stays centered on the selected material’s recorded anchor with unchanged orientation; require actual3D fit, support capacity and containment for the changed phase/volume. No controlled displacement is authored. Before payment, unknown fit/support rejects; after legal commitment, late changed support/occupation makes an atomic paid failure. Later actual support loss, falling, fluid release or structural collapse follows its own source; no invented damage or energy packet.
spellLocalNEW.instantaneous: On success atomically retire consumed input quantity and create one successor material state with parent lineage and retained history. No ongoing dispellable application remains. Later suppression or dispel does not reverse completed ordinary matter. Actual suppression of caster-origin or any selected input/output manifestation at resolution blocks this indivisible transaction after legal payment, including partial coverage; no partial output or delayed release. No input restoration by recast or serialization.
spellLocalNEW.lots: Partial lots must already have a recorded nonoverlapping separable quantity and geometry before commitment. Reserve selected quantity/revision once. Output genealogy records mass from each parent. Competing work reservations reject; releases do not restore consumed material. Splitting or merging never duplicates ownership, magic, ingredient provenance or charges. If a reserved target is moved/consumed or changed before resolution, fail rather than substituting another lot.
spellLocalNEW.economy: Mithril trade good250gp/lb is distinct from5gp Mithril Mark and from historical Mithral-to-Brightsteel remapping. No assumed recipe-ingot equivalence. Compatible recipes require exact identity/properties/quantity and lawful knowledge; no equal-price substitution. Actual sales require a finite buyer and agreed quote. Output material remains genuinely valuable and reusable where supported; missing market/recipe evidence is a case hold, not a zero-value rule.
